fields.v: Team lifecycle rather than a development flow: /onboard -> (/promote-to-team) -> /spawn-team (collect task, decompose, propose lineup, user confirms, spawn) -> active loop with automatic checkpoints (TeammateIdle hook, 15-minute threshold) -> bench/offboard -> /reactivate-team after session end; messaging via /check-inbox and /handoff; read-only plan gate before larger teammate changes

fields.v: Design, not an evaluation: no measurement of benefit, no comparison with alternatives, no user study. Known gaps: checkpoint gate fails open for brand-new teammates; checkpoint writer/reader contract is a documentation convention, not checked; some detections rely on text patterns. Future: empirical evaluation of recovery reliability under real interruptions, overhead and usability; tighter lead/teammate protocol; less prompt-writing; more autonomous mode
